task: Flagship 5 (einvoice-preflight): FatturaPA one-cent tolerance and SdI error codes vs specification 1.9 text

doc_friction.issue: Said fatturapa.gov.it / agenziaentrate.gov.it were unreachable from the build host; both answered with 200 from this cloud session on 2026-11-13. Later runs should probe before assuming the block (README and build-fatturapa-schema.mjs comment now say so).
No --dry-run flag; --list is the listing option (guessed wrong first).

goal: Deepen a flagship with a hard correctness slice read from the primary source
notes: Read the Agenzia delle Entrate's Allegato A v1.9 (IT + EN PDFs) and XSD 1.2.3 directly. Official XSD hashes to the mirror-derived pin. Fixed 00421 (round half up before 1-cent tolerance), 00422 (per AliquotaIVA incl. cassa and Arrotondamento, 1 euro; was 1 cent per line per rate+Natura and skipped with cassa), IT-016 now a warning (no SdI code). Added 19 offline SdI rejections with `sdi` codes on findings. English translation's error table says 00422 '±1 eurocent', Italian says '±1 euro' twice. Verification: fatturapa.test.mjs 39/39; python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py einvoice-preflight -> '1 suites run, 0 failed' (after regenerating sample-audit-pack.html via build-sample-pack.mjs). Corpus: 50 public FatturaPA files (ZUGFeRD corpus, phax/ph-fatturapa tests, FatturaElettronica.NET samples) checked old vs new; every new verdict hand-checked against spec text, none a false positive by that text. node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs einvoice-preflight -> "preflight clean for einvoice-preflight" (exit 0).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: reading a 191-page Italian tax spec's error table, re-deriving three tolerances, 19 new checks with boundary tests and a 50-file corpus comparison: about a day for an e-invoicing engineer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
